changelog: **Machine sources are registered per organization; one generic account-event route (#2914).** A new tenant model `IntegrationSource` (`slug`, `label`, `enabled`, optional `apiKeyId`, `@@unique([orgId, slug])`, in `TENANT_MODELS`) is what `POST /api/integrations/[source]/events` resolves its slug to, inside the API key's organization: no key is a 401 for every slug, an unregistered, disabled, malformed, reserved or other-org slug is one `404 unknown_source`, and a source bound to one key answers `403 wrong_source_key` to the others. The previous single-source route and its libs are replaced by `src/lib/accountEventRule.ts` (pure, unit-tested: event types, opaque ids, `SOURCE_SLUG_PATTERN`, `RESERVED_SOURCE_SLUGS`), `accountEventSchema.ts`, `accountEventIngest.ts` and the resolver `integrationSources.ts`; the v1 envelope is generic (`referral_code`, `contact.first_name/last_name`, a generic event-type vocabulary; ids stored lower-cased) and `IntegrationEvent.provider` is the source's slug. Activity entries are `integration.event`, `integration.backward_refused` and `integration.new_journey`, now stamped with the org. Sources are registered with the operator CLI `prisma/register-integration-source.mjs` (dry run unless `--apply`); the demo marketing tenant gets a `demo-feed` source. The caller-less extra machine writer key in the contact-permission rule is removed (machines still write `NONE` only). Contract: `docs/integrations/account-events.md`. Unit `scripts/test/account-event-rule.test.mjs`, e2e `e2e/account-event-ingest.spec.ts`.
